name: Licarbazepine
aliases: 10-hydroxycarbamazepine, 10,11-dihydro-10-hydroxycarbamazepine, GP 47779, TRI477, eslicarbazepine, Aptiom®, BIA 2-194, S-licarbazepine
summary: Licarbazepine is a voltage-gated sodium channel blocker with anticonvulsant and mood-stabilizing effects that is related to oxcarbazepine. It is an active metabolite of oxcarbazepine. In addition, an enantiomer of licarbazepine, eslicarbazepine ((S)-(+)-licarbazepine), is an active metabolite of eslicarbazepine acetate.

summaryZh: 利卡西平（英語：Licarbazepine）是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C15H14N2O2，可作為電壓門控鈉離子通道的阻滯劑，能作為情緒穩定劑，也是奧卡西平在體內的活性代謝產物。
